message.content:
I don’t know how many drones each customer has—it’s not my job to track that. But I can tell you that some customers fly a lot more than others.

For example, the parcel company probably has dozens of drones buzzing around all day, while the hospital might only have a handful. The inspection company could be somewhere in between, depending on how many sites they’re checking.

What matters to me is how many drones are in a given zone or corridor at any time, not which company they belong to. That way, when a closure happens, I can see if it’s going to cause a big mess for anyone.
